headline: Northern Michigan end Saginaw Valley State's unbeaten start
dek: Northern Michigan won at Saginaw Valley State, where they had lost earlier this month, to take a fourth win against two defeats. The home side had not been beaten all season until then, which leaves Roosevelt and Purdue Northwest alone without a loss.
displaced_by: Saginaw Valley State lost at home to Northern Michigan on 2026-09-18: no longer unbeaten, and no longer sole top scorers, so the standing lines were untrue.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Saginaw Valley State alone have scored more than Davenport, St. Cloud State and Wisconsin-Parkside together.

wire.line: Roosevelt keeper Cedrik Strupler has conceded one goal all season, and unbeaten Purdue Northwest are the next side to try him.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, the earliest of them Northern Michigan's opening match against Green Bay.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Roosevelt's five wins are more than any other programme has managed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Luca Rosen has scored eight goals from twenty-seven shots for Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Matty Telfer has scored seven of Saginaw Valley State's seventeen goals, from eighteen shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Davenport's sixteen goals conceded are more than any other programme has let in.

last_match.line: Northern Michigan have won consecutive matches for the first time this season, having alternated wins and defeats until now.

next_match.line: Neither side has lost this season; Roosevelt have drawn more often than Purdue Northwest, who have won every match since their draw at Quincy.
